House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Capital Investment

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital improvements; appropriating money for the West 7th Street Improvement Project in the city of St. Paul.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+ST. PAUL; WEST 7TH STREET IMPROVEMENT PROJECT. +]

[+(a) $80,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the Public Facilities Authority for a grant to the city of St. Paul for the city's West 7th Street Improvement Project to predesign, design, engineer, construct, and equip improvements to the roadway and underground water infrastructure from downtown St. Paul to the Mississippi River. +]

[+(b) This appropriation includes money to modernize underground tunnels and the stormwater and wastewater infrastructure within them, ease the financial burden of water infrastructure connections to properties, reconstruct roads and sidewalks to improve safety, install traffic calming facilities, realign intersections, and improve transit opportunities by facilitating the operation of a bus rapid transit line connecting downtown St. Paul, Minneapolis-St. Paul International Airport, and the Mall of America. +]

[+(c) This is a onetime appropriation and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital improvements; appropriating money for the West 7th Street Improvement Project in the city of St. Paul.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. ST. PAUL; WEST 7TH STREET IMPROVEMENT PROJECT.

(a) $80,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the Public Facilities Authority for a grant to the city of St. Paul for the city's West 7th Street Improvement Project to predesign, design, engineer, construct, and equip improvements to the roadway and underground water infrastructure from downtown St. Paul to the Mississippi River.

(b) This appropriation includes money to modernize underground tunnels and the stormwater and wastewater infrastructure within them, ease the financial burden of water infrastructure connections to properties, reconstruct roads and sidewalks to improve safety, install traffic calming facilities, realign intersections, and improve transit opportunities by facilitating the operation of a bus rapid transit line connecting downtown St. Paul, Minneapolis-St. Paul International Airport, and the Mall of America.

(c) This is a onetime appropriation and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.

(b) This appropriation includes money to modernize underground tunnels and the stormwater and wastewater infrastructure within them, ease the financial burden of water infrastructure connections to properties, reconstruct roads and sidewalks to improve safety, install traffic calming facilities, realign intersections, and improve transit opportunities by facilitating the operation of a bus rapid transit line connecting downtown St. Paul, Minneapolis-St. Paul International Airport, and the Mall of America.
(c) This is a onetime appropriation and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
